request.style: English, folk, male solo with choir, acoustic guitar, fiddle, hand drum, warm and celebratory, 110 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Shout to God with joy, all the earth
Sing the glory of his name
Make his praise glorious now

[Chorus]
How awesome are your works indeed
Your power is so great and true
Your enemies cringe before you

[Verse]
All the earth bows down to you
They sing to you in praise
Singing praise to your name

[Chorus]
How awesome are your works indeed
Your power is so great and true
Your enemies cringe before you

[Bridge]
Come and see what God has done
Awesome deeds toward men
Look upon the works of grace

[Chorus]
How awesome are your works indeed
Your power is so great and true
Your enemies cringe before you
